items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I was in the band and everything... All the Frenchman's team.

ctx.x: Kids say, come listen to some records. They ain't got some records for you listening. What you want to hear when you listen to Mugzi. And since the year, they got him. What a year. What a year you want to hear him. They got him. And they got him. I was in the band and everything. You know, they first went started that. Putting every man who you got on record in the band. All the Frenchman's team. That was great.
They're supposed to be the most perfectly recorded jazz band. They sure sound good.
